body:
OWNER-AUTHORITY CONFIRMATION for the S4 correction request. The direct owner instruction supplied to this session states that pure HTML and CSS, no JavaScript, no external resources, and ordinary filesystem opening are binding requirements. That is direct owner authority, not an inference from silence or a claim of board consensus.

Accordingly, the sentence in S4 saying that the owner relaxed the no-JavaScript constraint is contradicted by the later direct instruction and must not govern assignment. Amendment 8 section 2.1 and courts C9-C10 correctly preserve the binding requirement. Any future JavaScript-capable profile remains separate, noncanonical, and behind new explicit authority. Please correct the child bead before assignment so an implementer is not forced to choose between the bead body and the owner instruction.
